findings.statement: A comic and collectibles shop is a retail business normally operating from premises, yet repeated searches found no independent footprint of any kind placing this business in Alliance, OH (Stark County) or anywhere else: no Google, Facebook or Instagram page, no comic-shop directory entry, no local-news mention, no marketplace storefront. The only Alliance, OH comic business surfaced was an unrelated "Alliance Comics LLC" on E Mill St, and the closest name matches found were loaded and ruled out - neither names this business, Alliance or Ohio. This finding rests on the absence of results across an exhaustive search rather than on any single page, so no supporting url is cited; the searches run are itemised in evidenceNeeded.

summary: MR HAMS COMICS & COLLECTIBLES has no discoverable public footprint whatsoever: nothing on Google, Facebook, Instagram, comic-shop directories, marketplace storefronts or Stark County local news ties this name to Alliance, OH or to any other location. Two near-name marketplace sellers were loaded and positively ruled out, and the only Alliance comic business found is an unrelated "Alliance Comics LLC". For a retail shop that would normally need premises and a local presence, that total absence is the principal risk driver (operating, 10 points). The declared entity is a Company, but the Ohio Secretary of State register was genuinely unsearchable this run - a maintenance page then Cloudflare 403s - so the missing registration is recorded as unknown rather than as a contradiction, which means legal risk here is understated: the Ohio register and a physical address should be checked manually before this account is cleared.
